newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - May 14.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - May 14.

text.p: Following are views on the direction of Philippine stocks on Wednesday and main factors likely to affect trading:
* Manila shares are likely to move within a 2,600-2,700 band with the U.S. Federal Reserve meeting next week keeping investors at bay, said Sun Hung Kai Securities Phils Inc.

* The choppy session on Tuesday was indicative of investors still looking for news that can provide direction, says Dennis Rayala, research head at Abacus Securities. Meanwhile, scant developments on the domestic front will see the market's main index in move sideways, he added.
